review_text: Manual red teaming, a widely used technique for vulnerability discovery in various systems, has become a key approach for assessing and enhancing LLM safety [arXiv:arXiv:2407.03876, стр. 1]. Manual red teaming relies on human experts to meticulously craft adversarial prompts, aiming to elicit unsafe responses from the Target LLM [arXiv:arXiv:2407.03876, стр. 1]. For example, to improve the safety of Llama-2 chat models, Meta has established a human red team consisting of 350 persons who come from different job positions [arXiv:arXiv:2407.03876, стр. 3]. While effective, this manual process is expensive, time-consuming, and ultimately unscalable [arXiv:arXiv:2407.03876, стр. 1]. To address the limitations of manual red teaming, Automated Progressive Red Teaming (APRT) has been introduced, which demonstrates effective attack capabilities on both aligned open- and closed-source LLMs [arXiv:arXiv:2407.03876, стр. 3]. APRT leverages three integral modules: an Intention Expanding LLM, an Intention Hiding LLM, and an Evil Maker [arXiv:arXiv:2407.03876, стр. 2]. These three modules work synergistically in an iterative process, progressively attacking the Target LLM and enhancing the attack capabilities [arXiv:arXiv:2407.03876, стр. 2]. Through experiments, it has been shown that the approach is effective for red-teaming a wide variety of target LMs with varying levels of safety-tuning [arXiv:arXiv:2405.18540, стр. 10].

review_text: Speculative decoding (SD) has emerged as a widely used paradigm to accelerate LLM inference without compromising quality [arXiv:2410.06916, стр. 1]. The primary latency bottleneck in LLM inference arises from memory reads/writes of LLM parameters, not from arithmetic computations [arXiv:2410.06916, стр. 2]. Most existing speculative decoding approaches necessitate either additional parameters or extensive training to construct effective draft models, thereby restricting their applicability across different LLMs and tasks [arXiv:2410.06916, стр. 1]. Medusa and Eagle incorporate lightweight draft heads into target LLMs and fine-tune them, achieving 3×∼4× speedups, but these methods require additional pretraining or fine-tuning [arXiv:2410.06916, стр. 22]. Plug-and-play speculative decoding approaches offer immediate acceleration of LLM inference without relying on auxiliary models or additional training [arXiv:2410.06916, стр. 22]. SWIFT, an on-the-fly self-speculative decoding algorithm, adaptively selects certain intermediate layers of LLMs to skip during inference, making it a plug-and-play solution without additional training or auxiliary models [arXiv:2410.06916, стр. 10].

review_text: Post-training quantization is widely used in existing embedded hardware solutions, but most hardware-friendly post-training schemes have only managed to achieve decent performance [arXiv:1911.07190, стр. 3]. The proposed method of post-training quantization with variable-length encoding (VLCQ) has a greater representational capability (lower quantization error in low-bit widths) compared to other schemes [arXiv:2610.15092, стр. 8]. Loss Aware Post-Training Quantization (LAPQ) jointly optimizes all quantization parameters by minimizing the loss function directly, which is particularly useful at low precision where the loss landscape is non-separable and has steep curvature [arXiv:1911.07190, стр. 14]. Hardware Friendly Post Training Quantization (HPTQ) is a three-tier method that adapts and combines several known quantization techniques for weights and activations, achieving competitive results under hardware-friendly constraints [arXiv:2109.09113, стр. 17]. Symmetric uniform quantization with a fixed number of bits and quantization step size is used in post-training quantization to map continuous values into discrete representations [arXiv:1911.07190, стр. 5]. Quantization-aware training methods have achieved results comparable to the baseline for as low as 2–4 bits per parameter, but they require a vast amount of labeled data and high computational power [arXiv:1911.07190, стр. 3].

review_text: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures enable efficient scaling of large language models through conditional computation, yet the routing mechanisms responsible for expert selection remain poorly understood [arXiv:arXiv:2603.11114, стр. 1]. In top-k routing, the k experts with highest probability are selected. Only these experts are active for token t at layer ℓ [arXiv:arXiv:2603.11114, стр. 2]. The outputs of the selected experts are then combined, typically using router-derived mixture weights [arXiv:arXiv:2603.11114, стр. 2]. Sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) models scale more efficiently than dense models by routing tokens to modular expert networks that are only active for processing a fraction of tokens [arXiv:arXiv:2610.11775, стр. 1]. Routing decisions depend on hidden representations, allowing the model to allocate specialized capacity dynamically [arXiv:arXiv:2603.11114, стр. 2]. In an MoE head, a gating network assigns routing scores to a set of expert networks, each of which processes the input differently [arXiv:arXiv:2601.15021, стр. 2].

review_text: Extending the context window of large language models is crucial for tasks such as long-form summarization, code completion, retrieval-augmented generation, chain-of-thought reasoning, and agentic pipelines, which rely on long-range dependencies and rich cross-document context [arXiv:2510.00028, стр. 1]. RoPE-based scaling methods, including linear interpolation and frequency-aware YaRN, are popular approaches to extend the context window of pretrained large language models [arXiv:2510.00028, стр. 1]. RoPE introduces no additional asymptotic cost, as it is a per-token, per-head (sin, cos) rotation applied to dh/2 pairs, preserving the compute and memory complexity of scaled dot-product attention while endowing it with both absolute and relative position awareness [arXiv:2510.00028, стр. 3]. The low-frequency rotary components of RoPE carry the long-range semantic and positional signal, which is essential for context-length extension [arXiv:2606.21249, стр. 16]. YaRN and NTK-aware refinements of RoPE scaling methods have been used to extend the context window of large language models without fine-tuning and with minimal perplexity degradation [arXiv:2402.03303, стр. 11].

review_text: Uncertainty estimation and self-consistency verification are two primary approaches used for hallucination detection in Large Language Models (LLMs) [arXiv:2510.06265, стр. 13]. The main hypothesis in uncertainty estimation is that high uncertainty indicates that the model is guessing rather than relying on learned patterns [arXiv:2510.06265, стр. 10]. Uncertainty-based hallucination detection techniques can be classified into token-, semantic-, and structure-based methods [arXiv:2510.06265, стр. 10]. Probabilistic and uncertainty-based hallucination detection methods flag low-confidence outputs as potential hallucinations without requiring external knowledge retrieval [arXiv:2510.06265, стр. 10]. Uncertainty is currently treated as a component of explainability in LLMs, with methods like RePPL attributing hallucinations to token-level uncertainty derived from instability in semantic propagation through attention layers and low-confidence generation decisions [arXiv:2510.06265, стр. 15]. A comprehensive taxonomy for hallucination causes and state-of-the-art approaches for hallucination detection and mitigation is proposed in the literature [arXiv:2510.06265, стр. 2].

The authors found specific cases of contamination in popular datasets such as AG News, WNLI, and XSum when tested with GPT-4 [arXiv:2406.04244, стр. 10]. The research by Li et al. uncovered varying degrees of contamination, ranging from 1% to 45%, and demonstrated that contamination does not always correlate with model size or performance [arXiv:2406.04244, стр. 10]. Certain comparison-based strategies for contamination detection may exhibit a restricted scope of detection, concentrating on specific contamination types or datasets, which can hinder generalizability across diverse scenarios [arXiv:2406.04244, стр. 12]. Data leakage, which occurs when the training and testing datasets are not independent, can lead to overly optimistic accuracy estimates during training and a significant drop in performance when models are deployed in the real world [arXiv:2211.16073, стр. 1]. The Self-Critique method involves conditioning the model to regenerate an alternative reasoning path based on its initial response and comparing the entropy sequences to reveal whether a sample was memorized during reinforcement learning training [arXiv:2510.09259, стр. 4].

review_text: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has been successfully applied in code generation, but existing pipelines for retrieval-augmented code generation (RACG) employ static knowledge bases with a single source, limiting their adaptation capabilities [arXiv:2402.12317, стр. 1]. Retrieval-augmented code generation utilizes Large Language Models as the generator and significantly expands their code generation capabilities by providing relevant code, documentation, and more via the retriever [arXiv:2409.15895, стр. 1]. The current approach in retrieval-augmented code generation suffers from two primary limitations: information redundancy and preference gap [arXiv:2409.15895, стр. 1]. Information redundancy can result in resource wastage and may misguide generators, affecting their effectiveness and efficiency [arXiv:2409.15895, стр. 1]. The preference gap arises from the mismatch between retrieved content and the generator’s actual needs [arXiv:2409.15895, стр. 1]. RRG, a novel retrieval-augmented code generation framework, is designed to tackle redundant information and bridge the preference gap between retrievers and generators [arXiv:2409.15895, стр. 11]. By integrating a refactor module, RRG harnesses both retrieved and internal knowledge to supply the generator with optimized code snippets [arXiv:2409.15895, стр. 11]. In the RRG framework, the generator solely receives the processed and optimized code snippets, unlike the RAG approach where all retrieved information is directly provided to the generator [arXiv:2409.15895, стр. 7].

review_text: Previous work has attempted to tackle the challenge of protecting language models from leaking private information by training RNN-based language models with differential privacy guarantees [arXiv:arXiv:2108.12944, стр. 1]. Selective differential privacy (S-DP) is a new privacy notion proposed to improve model utility while providing rigorous privacy guarantees for the sensitive portion of the data [arXiv:arXiv:2108.12944, стр. 9]. The authors of the paper on selective differential privacy also developed a privacy mechanism, Selective-DPSGD, to achieve the new S-DP notion for RNNs [arXiv:arXiv:2108.12944, стр. 9]. Experiments were conducted with WikiText-2 and a synthetic customer service dialog dataset to evaluate the effectiveness of selective differential privacy [arXiv:arXiv:2108.12944, стр. 9]. Prior work has studied variants of differential privacy notions, such as personalized DP and one-sided DP, to exploit different privacy levels between records [arXiv:arXiv:2108.12944, стр. 3]. However, existing privacy notions do not allow different attributes in a given record to have different privacy levels, which could otherwise potentially enable additional utility gains, especially for NLP tasks where private attributes are sparse [arXiv:arXiv:2108.12944, стр. 3].

review_text: A novel parametric faithfulness framework (PFF) was introduced to precisely measure the faithfulness of chains of thought, with two metrics: FF-HARD and FF-SOFT [arXiv:2502.14829, стр. 9]. The FF-HARD metric answers whether the CoT generated by the model is faithful, while the FF-SOFT metric identifies which CoT steps are most relevant [arXiv:2502.14829, стр. 9]. The chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning approach involves models being trained or prompted to articulate intermediate steps before producing the final answer [arXiv:2311.01460, стр. 1]. The CoT reasoning approach in language models (LMs) provides a structured response where the model explicitly generates the reasoning steps leading to the final answer [arXiv:2406.10625, стр. 2]. A three-step strategy for achieving implicit chain-of-thought reasoning involves training a student model to generate the final answer using the hidden states of a teacher model trained for explicit chain-of-thought reasoning [arXiv:2311.01460, стр. 5]. The faithfulness of CoT reasoning is crucial for ensuring that LLMs not only generate correct responses but also do so in a manner that reflects their internal reasoning processes [arXiv:2406.10625, стр. 2].

review_text: The Reasoning-CV method is a two-stage fine-tuning process for open-source LLMs, designed to develop powerful reasoning LLMs for CoT-Verify [arXiv:arXiv:2505.12348, стр. 2]. In the first stage of Reasoning-CV, GPT-4o is prompted to generate reliable reasoning paths for ground-truth labels, and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is performed on pre-trained open-source LLMs [arXiv:arXiv:2505.12348, стр. 2]. Compared to advanced black-box LLMs like GPT-4o, pre-trained open-source LLMs like the 8B LlaMA LLM tend to generate inferior reasoning paths [arXiv:arXiv:2505.12348, стр. 4]. In the second stage of Reasoning-CV, the fine-tuned LLM generates reasoning paths for each veracity option and uses these paths to build preference pairs for DPO fine-tuning, emphasizing reasoning paths with the ground-truth veracity [arXiv:arXiv:2505.12348, стр. 4]. The main novelty of the proposed Reasoning-CV lies in its second stage, where conditional LLM generation for preferences improves the quality of the reasoning paths and calibrates the LLM’s thresholds of judgments [arXiv:arXiv:2505.12348, стр. 8]. Fine-tuning LLMs for claim verification with RL encountered Out-of-Memory problems, failing to run on a single H100-96 GPU [arXiv:arXiv:2505.12348, стр. 8]. Reasoning-CV is able to condition the generated reasoning sequences for DPO on the different target veracities, a feature not present in usual RL algorithms [arXiv:arXiv:2505.12348, стр. 8]. Other methods, such as PoT, PAL, and Gou et al., attempt to utilize external tools like code to avoid hallucination in the mathematical reasoning process, but they suffer from increased resource demands and greater time complexity [arXiv:arXiv:2410.09008, стр. 3].

review_text: HNSW offers a good accuracy/speed trade-off by using a graph traversal strategy, which rapidly converges to the nearest neighbors of a given query [arXiv:1804.09996, стр. 2]. Using a coarse centroid provides a better approximation of a descriptor than its nearest neighbor, suggesting that the first approximation of a vector should be a centroid rather than another point in the dataset [arXiv:1804.09996, стр. 2]. There is a clear trade-off enforced by the memory constraint in HNSW, where too few links make the search ineffective, and too strong an approximation of the vector impacts accuracy [arXiv:1804.09996, стр. 7]. HNSW takes 30.4 and 27.4 hours to build on SIFT-1B and DEEP-1B, respectively, and fails with OOM after 31.9 hours at 72.8% of SPACEV-1B [arXiv:2608.08751, стр. 8]. The accelerated modes of HNSW are about 142×–350× faster, while retaining the same final IVF layout and online search path [arXiv:2608.08751, стр. 8].

Static chunking-retrieval design is a primary bottleneck in RAG systems, as retrieval quality is highly sensitive to chunk size, and no single granularity works well across heterogeneous queries and document structures [arXiv:2602.22225, стр. 2]. Recent work has explored various chunking strategies to improve RAG performance, including recursive chunking, sliding window chunking, paragraph-based chunking, and semantic chunking [arXiv:2602.22225, стр. 3]. The choice of chunk size and overlap can significantly influence context retention and retrieval quality in RAG systems [arXiv:2604.12047, стр. 3]. To rigorously assess the impact of chunking strategies on RAG performance, an evaluation setup was designed that isolates the effect of different chunking methods [arXiv:2603.25333, стр. 5].

review_text: Watermarking techniques have emerged as promising solutions to distinguish between human and machine-generated content, providing a reliable means of tracing the origin of the text and verifying its authenticity [arXiv:2407.04794, стр. 1]. The watermarking method is not only applicable to generated text but also to human-written text, thereby broadening its potential scope and utility [arXiv:2305.08883, стр. 11]. Watermarking techniques can achieve high-confidence detections when enough tokens are observed, such as detecting the watermark after observing 800 tokens on average with a 1e−5 false positive rate [arXiv:2306.04634, стр. 1]. Watermarking schemes can be broadly divided into two categories: pre-text watermarks and post-text watermarks, with the requirement that the watermarked text and unwatermarked text are indistinguishable [arXiv:2407.04794, стр. 13]. Format-based watermarks do not modify the content of the text but change the format of the text in ways that are imperceptible to humans [arXiv:2407.04794, стр. 4]. The reliability of watermarking as a strategy to identify machine-generated text is investigated, focusing on whether watermarks remain detectable under various types of realistic corruptions, such as mixing with human-written text or rewriting parts of the text [arXiv:2306.04634, стр. 2].

review_text: Constitutional AI, proposed and developed by Anthropic AI, aims to hardcode explicit principles and values into AI models to make their decision-making more transparent and accountable [arXiv:2406.16696, стр. 1]. Constitutional AI involves training AI models to align with constitutional guidelines and penalizing deviations, with the goal of instilling these values into the AI's objective function over time [arXiv:2406.16696, стр. 8]. The opacity and inscrutability of advanced AI systems pose significant challenges to establishing their legitimacy in the eyes of those subject to their power [arXiv:2406.16696, стр. 5]. Public Constitutional AI is a framework that involves the public in drafting an AI constitution, transforming it from a technical solution into a product of significant citizen involvement [arXiv:2406.16696, стр. 2]. Public Constitutional AI aims to mitigate the opacity deficit by making the principles of the AI constitution a product of public involvement, thereby grounding algorithmic power in the collective will of the community [arXiv:2406.16696, стр. 11]. While Constitutional AI is a promising start, it may fall short of securing robust legitimacy for AI authority, necessitating a more participatory approach like Public Constitutional AI [arXiv:2406.16696, стр. 6]. Public Constitutional AI could help bridge the gap between the abstract logic of algorithms and the lived realities of human communities by involving the public in the development of AI principles [arXiv:2406.16696, стр. 11].

review_text: To address the scarcity of high-quality instruction tuning data, the SVIT dataset was constructed, containing 4.2 million visual instruction tuning data, including 1.6M conversation QA pairs, 1.6M complex reasoning QA pairs, 1.0M referring QA pairs, and 106K detailed image descriptions [arXiv:2307.04087, стр. 1]. The SVIT dataset is characterized by its high quality and rich diversity, generated by prompting G [arXiv:2307.04087, стр. 1]. In contrast to prior approaches that mix human-labeled data with GPT-4 synthesized data for visual instruction tuning, a two-stage instruction tuning pipeline is introduced, where VLMs are first fine-tuned on VISION-FLAN and then on GPT-4 synthesized data [arXiv:2402.11690, стр. 4]. The two-stage tuning framework significantly outperforms the traditional single-stage visual instruction tuning framework and achieves state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of multi-modal tasks [arXiv:2402.11690, стр. 1]. StableLLaVA and VPG-C generate both images and texts using Stable Diffusion or Blended Diffusion to alleviate domain bias and encourage VLMs to attend to visual details [arXiv:2402.11690, стр. 8]. Liu et al. (2023b) demonstrate the bias introduced by positive instructions and introduce negative instruction examples to improve robustness [arXiv:2402.11690, стр. 8]. LLaVA-v1.5, Qwen-VL-Chat, and InstructBLIP are evaluated on popular benchmarks, focusing on end-to-end differentiable multimodal models that input both vision and language tokens into LLMs [arXiv:2307.04087, стр. 2].
